hooks.name: Update MASTER-PLAN progress on task completion

action.command: FILE="{{filePath}}"; TOTAL=$(grep -c '^- \[' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); DONE=$(grep -c '^- \[x\]' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$TOTAL" -gt 0 ] && [ "$TOTAL" -eq "$DONE" ]; then SPEC=$(echo "$FILE" | sed 's|.*/specs/||' | sed 's|/tasks.md||'); echo "✅ All $TOTAL tasks complete in $SPEC"; fi
